page_layout_faq_default_answer_01.value: As an Australian shopper, you are fully protected by the Australian Consumer Law. All our spices and chili blends come with automatic guarantees that cannot be excluded. You are entitled to products that are safe, of premium culinary quality, and accurately described. If your order ever arrives damaged, leaking, unsealed, or not as described, you have the right to an immediate replacement or a full refund.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_01.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_02.value: Yes! All prices across our Australian store are displayed in Australian Dollars (AUD) with 10% Goods and Services Tax (GST) already included. What you see on our product pages is exactly what you pay at checkout with zero surprise surcharges. An official Australian Tax Invoice showing our ABN and the GST amount is emailed automatically with every order.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_02.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_03.value: To help you easily compare value across different jar sizes and blends, we follow the Australian Unit Pricing Code. Every product listing displays both the total package price and the standard unit price (such as price per 100 grams), alongside certified metric net weights (strictly excluding the glass jar weight).
page_layout_faq_default_answer_03.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_04.value: We take food safety and allergen transparency very seriously under the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code. All ingredients and allergens are clearly declared in plain English on both our website and product labels. For example, our signature Shrimp Chilli clearly highlights dried shrimp (crustacea) and sesame. Meanwhile, our pure chili flakes and whole dried pods are 100% plant-based, gluten-free, and prepared with zero artificial colors or preservatives.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_04.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_05.value: In accordance with Australia's Country of Origin Food Labelling rules, every jar and pouch displays clear origin information. For our handcrafted blends combining specialty imported peppers (such as Ghost Pepper, Bird's Eye, and Habanero) with fresh Australian garlic, shallots, and cold-pressed Australian oils, our packaging openly shows the percentage of Australian ingredients.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_05.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_06.value: Our collection spans from mild, fruity, and aromatic (such as Ancho chili at 1,000–2,000 Scoville Heat Units) to scorching heat (like our Ghost Pepper and Carolina Reaper blends exceeding 800,000 SHU). Every product displays an easy-to-read 1-to-5 flame rating and Scoville estimate so you know exactly what level of heat you are getting into.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_06.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_07.value: Orders placed Monday to Friday before 2:00 PM AEST are packed and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours. Standard Australia Post delivery takes 3 to 5 business days for metro areas (4 to 7 for regional), and Express Priority arrives in 1 to 2 business days. We provide Free Standard Shipping on all Australian orders of $50.00 AUD or more ($4.99 AUD under $50, or $9.99 AUD for Express).
page_layout_faq_default_answer_07.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_08.value: We offer a 30-day return policy on any unopened jar or spice pouch with the factory tamper seal intact for a full product refund. Under Australian food safety laws and state food hygiene regulations (such as the NSW Food Act), we cannot accept returns on jars once opened, unsealed, or tasted, due to health and safety risks. However, this hygiene rule never affects your statutory rights: if a jar arrives broken, damaged, or defective, we will gladly replace it or issue a full refund immediately.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_08.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_09.value: You are completely protected by our damage replacement guarantee. For your safety, do not mail broken glass back to us. Simply take a quick photo of the damaged package and email it to support@driedchili.com with your order number. We will dispatch a brand-new replacement via express post right away or give you a full 100% refund.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_09.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_10.value: We respect your personal details under the Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles. We only collect the necessary information to deliver your orders and manage your account. We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data to advertisers. Online payments are processed through secure, bank-level encrypted checkout partners (Stripe and PayPal), so your card numbers are never stored on our website.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_10.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_11.value: We hate spam as much as you do. Under Australia's Spam Act 2003, we only send newsletters or special recipe discounts if you explicitly chose to opt in. Every marketing email includes a quick 1-click Unsubscribe link at the bottom, and you can opt out instantly anytime at no cost.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_11.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_12.value: All our chili blends and sauces are produced in registered commercial food premises overseen by state food authorities and certified Food Safety Supervisors. We maintain strict hygiene protocols, routine temperature monitoring, and dedicated allergen separation to ensure every jar is clean, fresh, and safe.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_12.label: Answer

page_layout_faq_default_answer_13.value: Store your chili jars tightly sealed in a cool, dark, and dry pantry away from direct sunlight, stovetop heat, and humidity. Always use a clean, dry spoon to avoid introducing moisture into chili crisp jars. Sealed jars have an optimal Best Before shelf life of up to 18 to 24 months from the production date printed on the base.
page_layout_faq_default_answer_13.label: Answer
